title: Non-Adaptive Learning of Sparse Erdős--Rényi Graphs via Affine Splitting
summary: Graph learning from edge-detecting queries concerns the reconstruction of an unknown edge set on a known vertex set. Each query reports whether a specified vertex subset contains at least one edge. We study non-adaptive schemes, in which all queries are fixed before any outcomes are observed, with the goal of achieving exact recovery using few queries and fast decoding. For general graphs on $n$ vertices with at most $k$ edges, non-adaptive recovery requires $Ω(\min\{k^2\log n,n^2\})$ queries in the worst case, even when a small error probability is allowed.
